title: Orsen and the Salt
author: Mara Nystrom
blurb: Petra Joubert, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
